notes.title: The Developers Behind Flavor Favor
notes.content:
You've already met the fascinating game characters, and now it's time to introduce the talented game developers behind the scenes.

Masha Loutanina - 2D artist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/3992d743f3d29165585a7cff373175df80d4289b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/7caf74a5ad8a343e089ee8b9e2e3d94b98451a7c.png
Besides being the character artist for Flavor Favor, Masha is also a project manager and 2D game artist. To learn more, you can check out her website. Her favorite snack is taiyaki, with its nice texture and red bean filling.

Niki Chalusi - producer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/d3131a0220f5ab6130dc36347c20ab497a814a2a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/eb282db35e6a08e1fc2e879bf72f1ee94f1e9009.png
Niki came up with the snack idea a year ago while daydreaming in class. One of the best parts of producing Flavor Favor has been the possibility of working together with other creative souls. Besides dried mangos, she really enjoys waffles with cream and fruit.

Edwin Safari - writer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/e8d7490e19158d2b63722c42086daca895c0f3b8.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/7ca1f1184e3ff6f60e204b510d372ac8a9258b7a.png
The mastermind behind the story and the worldbuilding is none other than Edwin, who is a scriptwriter, video editor, and drag queen. You can check out their alter-egos homepage. Edwin likes sipping on fruity nostalgia.

Mira Aasma - music and sound director
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/ec8b85b3b846df8789d383f6783318455c40d680.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/dc12103714b7481970f604372d653f488a5f345c.png
Mira has experience in various creative fields: theater, film production, and songwriting. Learn more about her artistry and music on Spotify. She really enjoys parfait.

Elias Eriksson - programmer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/b2fd5c460fba4e6e0e9c852510735d2ea36b18e2.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/94f32feab401195f486104e123df1075e980e437.png
Elias is the magician behind Flavor Favor. When he's not programming, he enjoys participating in Super Smash Bros tournaments. His favorite snack is popcorn.

Marx Fidel - environment artist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/0c4992b48522d30f26396c2ad00a4b9393c9e920.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/be7be288b250d1d2a2e92e7578de52ea1e738c5c.png
Marx is an illustrator and comic artist. He is the one creating the environment for the island of Tuinu. Check out his page. His favorite snack is yogurt.

We sincerely hope that you will enjoy the gaming experience of Flavor Favor. We have certainly enjoyed making it. Being our first game, it has been imaginative and fun. It means a lot to us knowing that you are curious about trying it out.

notes.title: Flavor Favor's Rich Narrative Experience!
notes.content:
Greetings, Flavor Favor enthusiasts!

We're thrilled to unveil a key aspect of our upcoming visual novel adventure: an abundance of dialogue choices that'll keep you engaged and enthralled like never before. Flavor Favor is a unique visual novel in that way—it has an interactive narrative where you make dialogue decisions every other turn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/e8299100753096e35fa799e6a7aa4feefca717fb.gif

From heartwarming exchanges to tense confrontations, Flavor Favor presents a myriad of opportunities for you to express yourself through dialogue. Whether you're forging friendships, unraveling mysteries, or shaping the fate of the world around you, your choices matter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/146a65e1ead824c7fd6f2cf6999b3f31aa16f1cb.gif

Prepare to be captivated by compelling characters, intricate relationships, and morally ambiguous dilemmas. With Flavor Favor, the power lies in your hands—are you ready to wield it?

Stay tuned for more updates as we delve deeper into the flavorful world of Flavor Favor. Your adventure awaits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/42c171ebb633cb10dafdf411053d60524a00c22e.png

notes.title: Meet the characters🌸
notes.content:
"They call themselves 'The Blossoms'. In reality, they are anarchy punks." - mainland newspaper headline

In connection with your choices, you will get to know one character but not another. Can you figure out who prefers the personality type aggressor, charmer, and diplomat?

A cold personality to hide the pain she carries. Can you find out what she wants most?

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/eaaf7281015d6a73701a7bd5071a72cc447c7d29.png


A scientist who does everything in their power to change their friends’ predetermined fates as immortal servants.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/10a29298252bd78f31e6583653365efa74b8fde7.png

 

The happiest soul you will ever meet. It’s hard to believe that there are several thousand copies of them.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/3aec0519e6905884790edcabd656fb3421ad7c84.png

 

Clumsy in social situations and a heart of gold.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/c81e02add79bef1557c3cb7d26c2a29735944db8.png

 

The human who stands by their side. She is caring and loyal.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/7007c4cae3a46b2fd567ad9332b6e0470b84ef8b.png

 

The friendliest and sweetest. Wants to bring harmony and peace to the world through gaianism.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/f34665a7374c5d265c754f6058c4ea7ec36d6ea9.png

 

Ex-military and sly as a fox. It can be difficult to deal with her if one does not set boundaries.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/392fe2a690c04425d55b1526a1eee8e8951b5556.png

 

Commercially created to satisfy people’s desires. Reserved and cautious.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images//44021433/287344a82b4cd2f9a2cd0f7c007810297dcb1f18.png


Who do you want to know better?

notes.title: Fight, charm or question
notes.content:
Personality Routes

The choices you make in Flavor Favor will lead to different outcomes. Some characters will appreciate your feisty spirit, while others may not.

The decisions you make will also affect the relationships between characters and the overall story progression. Choose wisely and see how your actions shape the world of Flavor Favor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021433/408065eabfeb58354c7819368e6dbf08e7d1881e.gif

AGGRESSOR🔥
There’s no use in talking sense into them! If they’re trying to kill me, I’ll kill them first! The only way out of this is through brutish strength, intimidation, and forceful coercion.

CHARMER💐
I better calm down and take a softer approach. There’s nothing better than wit, charm, and kindness. A little empathy goes a long way.

DIPLOMAT🎓
Let’s be smart about this, better to be strategic and gather all the information I can rather than say or do something I might regret later. Diplomacy, tactfulness, and curiosity will guide me.

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
Get ready!

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 14 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound. 

Watch the broadcast from Flavor Favor's sound director Mira Aasma and narrative lead Jafar the Superstar!

Don’t miss out on updates!

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on saveandsound.io
